{{Short description|Concept in algebraic geometry}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2025}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Humbert surface''', studied by {{harvs|txt||last=Humbert|authorlink=Marie Georges Humbert|year=1899}}, is a [[surface (mathematics)|surface]] in the [[moduli space]] of principally polarized [[abelian surface]]s consisting of the surfaces with a symmetric [[endomorphism]] of some fixed [[discriminant]].
